dtmb.label: DTMB terrestrial TV
dtmb.parsing: This detector checks PN420 / PN595 / PN945 and repeated 3780-symbol frame bodies. The enabled television reception module separately verifies system information, FEC, transport streams and playback; frame evidence alone does not establish decoded programmes.
dtmb.effect: A 12 ms continuous window is checked every second, without requiring a power change. Complete 8 MHz channels must fit inside the receiver passband; estimated centers must lie within Search width. Wider inputs use overlapping analysis channels and require more CPU. Busy analysis windows are counted separately from receiver sample loss.
dtmb.summary: PN and frame timing evidence; programme reception is assessed separately
dtmb.outside: Requires at least 8 MS/s and a complete 8 MHz receiver passband. Filter clipping, noise and reception conditions can prevent identification even when the configuration is compatible.
